bullets.section: Short video I’ve watched at least 10 times (do NOT try this at home) —
bullets.title: Can’t stop watching this
DF “Distraction Free” Tube
bullets.note: Noise and distraction online are endless. It’s nice to have tools to clean up the mess a bit. I learned about DF Tube from uber-entrepreneur/investor [Caterina Fake’s blog](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/r8u063gzzaoh5mv3v/mmb7h5hg9pqrx0/aHR0cHM6Ly9jYXRlcmluYS5uZXQvMjAxOS8wMi8wNS8zLXJlY29tbWVuZGF0aW9ucy1rYW5vcHktcmVjb21lbmRvLWFuZC1kZi10dWJlLw==). Here is her description: “This is a chrome plugin that eliminates all the cruft around a YouTube video. For the past few months I’ve been trying to force YouTube to show me palatable content on my sidebar, but no matter how much crap I reject as “Not Interested” more crap appears. Since the font of crap is inexhaustible, I searched for a YouTube cleanup plugin. DF Tube–Distraction Free Tube–is so great! Everything bad — recommendations on the sidebar, crap on the homepage, inane commentary — vanishes!”

bullets.title: Gnossienne No. 3, by Erik Satie
bullets.note: I’ve been exploring minor key music after [my recent conversation with Susan Cain](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/r8u063gzzaoh5mv3v/ozukhqhknv6ze8/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE5LzAxLzI0L3N1c2FuLWNhaW4vP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9Y29udmVydGtpdCZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWNvbnZlcnRraXQmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTViZg==). Although often thought of as “sad” music, she believes minor key music can help you better experience the full spectrum of the human condition. For coming to peace with inevitable “undesirable” emotions, that seems like a good thing and a good practice. I still favor [bossa nova and more upbeat music](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/r8u063gzzaoh5mv3v/p3ieh9h3d02ve9/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g_dj1RenF6SlJuN3BtYw==) most of the time (and I listen to it as a palate cleanser after the minor key stuff), but I’m giving greater variance a shot...
